29443: Lavia Bianchi, the eldest daughter and heir of the old-line noble House Bianchi in Steelland, is a famously eccentric young lady. Her exquisite face and elegant demeanor mirror noble ladies from classical paintings, but her Trait and actions starkly contrast this image. Gossips pair her with Vera, eldest daughter of the Spring family, dubbing her the "Steelland rose"—though this bud hides too many thorns.#r The Bleed conflict sparked by the Osoron incident reshaped Steelland's political scene. As a symbol of the old nobility and enforcer of armed crackdowns, House Bianchi crumbled in the ensuing purge. Marquis Bianchi was executed, Family vassals scattered, and only Lady Joanna remained to pick up the pieces, struggling to uphold the ancient Family's honor.#r Lavia was only six when all this happened. The once-innocent princess grew up amid public scorn and noble disdain, her pure smile gone forever. As Bianchi's future head, she became a formidable knight, earning her supporters' respect, yet she never learned the deceit and hypocrisy at noble tables or adapted to bulky whalebone skirts and intricate social rituals. A willful noble knight—powerful, dangerous, moody, and elusive: that's the label Steelland gave her.#r After coming of age, Lavia skipped Pestle College as tradition dictated and joined the Knights Wildhorse, wielding her lance to settle disputes beyond ballrooms. Though an oddball to nobles, House Bianchi slowly recovered through mother and daughter teamwork.#r Madness and defiance fend off hidden threats; when malice and schemes surround you, thorns make solid armor. But when danger fades... can the thorn-bound soul shed its mask and reclaim the self long lost?

29592: "Warrior's oath outweighs gold." Contract sealed, my blade moves for you till sands bury me, till storms carry me to rest in tomb.

29601: I think… I've found my second "home".

29603: You're all right—I'll stick with you from now on. Point east and I won't head west. Do keep Old Yue's matter in mind. This ain't a transaction, just comrades helping comrades.

29605: Tired of others' tales and craving your own epic? Fair warning—what song to write is my call!
29606: With my father's blessing, I ride as your knight. Here stands no Hellason heir—only Rebuke Knight Neil. Judgment Awaits. Onward, [player].
29607: I've returned the Iron Ember Congregation's sigil. Though no longer a Judicator, I'll still serve as executioner if needed. Let my hands bear necessary evils so yours stay clean.
29608: Master only said to train outside, didn't say I couldn't find companions... Well, making friends must also be part of the training, no problem with that! So we're companions, hehe, let's celebrate! What shall we eat later?
29609: We both bear destinies... [player]. May we honor this journey we share.
29610: I've seen enough of the martial world, the chivalrous spirit has been severed by fame and fortune. In you, I see another possibility, something Bai Qiuyu, Luo Wenyu, and I have been searching for.
29611: Past bonds are severed. Now I seek new purpose. [player], show me this world.
29612: I shall serve under your command from now on, please bear with me. Zhe-Jing Division? Oh, not at all. After that incident, I'm no longer associated with Zhe-Jing Division.
29613: Flora Aurelian, at your service. I value your trust deeply, but those close to me often face misfortune. When misfortune catches up with me, please leave me behind; don't get caught in this unmerited disaster.
29614: You are a straightforward person, and it is my honor to accompany you. More friends mean more paths, in the martial world, one should forge many good connections and support each other.
29615: Nothing better to do, might as well wander with you. You sent the invitation—no backing out, you know~
29616: Guo Jiaojiao's sweet talk left Yu bewildered, and that young swordsman might actually help her ask Wang Xiao-San for money. Wait for a day and then check back at the Dong-Lai Tavern.
29617: Being respectful is a virtue, but some see it as a sign of weakness. If someone takes advantage and acts up, they shouldn't be surprised if a hard punch comes their way.
29618: The mission failed, but judging by Ma San's expression, this seems to be the norm at the escort bureau. Anyway, thank goodness you both returned safely.
29619: Mission accomplished. Cheng Xiaoyan stirred up a lot of trouble, but in the end, things didn't turn out so bad...

29623: JoJo used to belong to the Mankinds, but that's just before. Now she's a lost pawn, driven mad, with nowhere to accept her anymore.

29889: Time to meet Swordsman Cui. Head to Luan City's tavern.

29892: The assassin's employer killed by Swordsman Cui was a Chen-Yuan Refugee. Overwhelmed by guilt, he took his own life. Now head to Wang-Gui yamen to question the Pacification Commissioner about the Refugee situation.
